verdict.rationale: Shopify Agentic Commerce is the server side of agent commerce. It exposes UCP-compliant MCP servers (Catalog, Cart, Checkout, Order) and a CLI that external agents use. It is not an agent or assistant that consumes third-party MCP servers, so 'plug MCP servers into it' is a client-role question that does not fit this product type. Nothing in the evidence shows it acting as an MCP client, which would have made the axis applicable.
